body: User workflow clarification: product/manual human acceptance happens AFTER the epic is done and merged, during ordinary use; issues then become bugs. Do not schedule user-performed UAT, manual smoke checks or subjective feature sign-off as implementation-ticket/sprint exit gates. Agents remain responsible for automated tests and agent-executable integration/native verification, with truthful limits. This does not authorize agents to approve Dark Mechanicus checkpoints, synthesize consent or bypass OS permissions; existing human checkpoint controls and explicit physical-input permission are distinct from product UAT. The current unsaved draft still contains manual-positive-control/native-run prerequisites and must be reconciled with this policy before Save/execution; do not silently count those cases as performed.
